g.data-exception-reason: Explicit Index alternatives sample the continuous contours near2mm pitch with1.2mm design circles. Centres closer than1.5mm are omitted at junctions. Trouser waistband and dress waist boundaries are sampled once. Apron loop and ties join body contour with duplicate dots omitted. All dot alternatives remain within the same shared master. These are design positions, not measured hardware properties.

g.data-design-reason: Reuse exact continuous geometry. Trousers, dress and apron panels receive lower grey surfaces and higher black outlines. Neck loop and side ties remain higher lines; loop centre and exterior gaps unraised. Pocket uses same lower surface role, without material texture. No measured height.
